name: Fresher Pippa

intro.text: First week and I've already lost my gown, my bike and my sense of direction. Fighting's the only thing I know how to do here.

win: Oh! You're good. Do you do tutorials? I'm told they are different from this.
after: Matriculation is when you join the University. You wear subfusc, which is the formal black and white, and a mortarboard you carry rather than wear. If you wear it, you won't graduate. That's the rule.
